title: Kay Starr date in 1945 and Ted Yerxa's Lamplighter records
summary: He recorded in Los Angeles with Willie Smith, Ray Linn, Calvin Jackson and Zutty, and Ted Yerxa of the Lamplighter, a Daily News columnist, put many musicians to work recording, including Vic Dickenson and Peggy Lee.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: In looking through these lists in the discography, I see a list of records made with Kay Starr in 1945.
Do you remember who else was on that date?

Well, yeah, every time we recorded, there were different guys on the date. Willie Smith was on some of them and Ray Linn was on a lot of them and the piano player I was telling you about. And Zutty was on most all of them.
You and Dorothy were saying that a lot of musicians in Los Angeles were discovered by --
-- Ted Yerxa, who was a columnist for the Los Angeles Daily News.
Yeah, that used to be the Lamplighter. And he had a lot of musicians put to work recording for him.
-- Vic Dickenson, yes, another one. And he brought back -- who's the girl singer who used to be with Benny Goodman? The blonde girl?
Oh, he brought her back from where and when?
From retirement when she left Benny.
He had Shorty Sherlock in there.
And that was all around about '45, '46?
